summary: The Emperador ransomware group listed the City Government of Baguio, Philippines, on its leak site on 12 August 2026. It claimed 2.9 GB of data including official contracts, permits, identification documents, financial statements, construction blueprints and procurement records. The city's online building permit system was taken offline, and digital-rights advocates called for a government investigation into the alleged attack.
